articles.headline: S&P 500 Short Interest Nears Highest Since 2010 — Market Commentator Warns 'Conditions for a Short-Squeeze Are Rising'
articles.summary: S&P 500 short interest nears 15-year highs. Experts warn "conditions for a short-squeeze are rising" as bearish bets surge.
articles._summary: Short interest in the S&P 500 index has climbed to approximately 3.7% of its free float—nearing its highest level since 2010—prompting market commentator The Kobeissi Letter to warn that “conditions for a short-squeeze are rising”. As traders build heavy short positions against American equities, these elevated short levels across key benchmarks are creating significant potential for a rapid upward market rally. Pessimistic sentiment is even more pronounced across the broader stock market .
articles._zh_headline: 标准普尔 500 指数空头兴趣接近 2010 年以来最高水平 — 市场评论员警告“空头挤压的条件正在上升”
articles._zh_summary: 标准普尔 500 指数的空头兴趣已攀升至其自由流通量的约 3.7%，接近 2010 年以来的最高水平，促使市场评论员 The Koheissi Letter 发出警告，“空头挤压的条件正在上升”。随着交易员对美国股市建立大量空头头寸，主要基准的空头水平不断上升，为市场快速上涨创造了巨大潜力。整个股市的悲观情绪更为明显。

articles._summary: The modest pullback follows a sharp rally fueled by optimism around artificial intelligence-driven memory demand. Morgan Stanley analyst Joseph Moore said the recent pullback in U.S. memory stocks presents an attractive buying opportunity. Moore expects memory prices to increase at least 25% from the second quarter to the third quarter of 2026 as data center memory shortages persist.

articles.headline: Stock Market: Will S&P 500 Open Up or Down Today?
articles.summary: July 22, 2026: Polymarket traders expect the S&P 500 to open lower on Wednesday as rising oil prices overshadow strong corporate earnings.
articles._summary: The S&P 500 rallied on Tuesday as strong corporate earnings and a rebound in semiconductor stocks lifted equities. However, Polymarket traders are betting the benchmark index will open lower on Wednesday as rising oil prices and renewed inflation concerns cloud the outlook. The S&P 500 gained 0.89% to close at 7,509.20. However, the July 22 Polymarket contract implied just a 15% probability that the index will open higher on Wednesday, with traders increasingly positioning for a weaker start.

articles.headline: Ross Gerber Renews Call For Disney Shake-Up After Stock Trails S&P 500 For 11 Years: 'Break Up The Mouse House Or Sell It'
articles.summary: Investor Ross Gerber renews Disney breakup call, says shareholders have "suffered too long" after 11 years of stock underperformance.
articles._summary: Gerber, who is also the CEO of Gerber Kawasaki , added that Disney’s individual businesses are worth more separately than together, saying shareholders have suffered too long. “Break up the mouse house or sell it,” Gerber added. Gerber also said Disney management had failed to unlock the value of its assets and argued shareholders were “sick of the dawdling” while executives continued to receive large compensation packages.

articles.summary: SK hynix denied a report it was in talks to buy Intel's Ohio chip campus, saying it has neither pursued nor decided on a deal.
articles._summary: SK hynix issued the clarification in a Korea Exchange filing after Korea JoongAng Daily reported that the company was negotiating to acquire the Ohio campus to establish front-end memory chip production in the U.S. within five years. In the filing, SK hynix said it is “continuously reviewing various investment and acquisition opportunities for business purposes,” but added that it “has not pursued or decided to acquire Intel’s Ohio site and Fab.”
